description.value: Persia Foods is a family-owned grocery chain that has served the Vancouver Lower Mainland since 1996, positioning itself as an affordable source of fresh, healthy, and ethnically diverse foods. The Commercial Drive location sits on one of Vancouver's most vibrant and cycle-friendly streets, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the city. With nine locations across Metro Vancouver, it is a well-established local institution known for cultural variety in its product range.
